stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be an abelian category. Let $f : M \to M$ be a morphism
of $\mathcal{A}$. If $M[f^n] = \Ker(f^n : M \to M)$ stabilizes, then the
inverse systems
$$
(M \xrightarrow{f^n} M)
\quad\text{and}\quad
\Coker(f^n : M \to M)
$$
are pro-isomorphic in $D(\mathcal{A})$.
